welcome.title: Just say it, I'll write it down
welcome.description: Track and check your expenses and income by chatting — typing or speaking. I pick the category and show you exactly what I saved.

examples.query: How much did I spend on the car this month?
examples.summary: Where did most of my money go in the last 30 days?

clear.title: Clear the conversation?
clear.description: The messages disappear from this screen, but your expenses, income and categories stay exactly as they are — clearing the chat undoes nothing it recorded. The history and the cost stay in the AI Log.

errors.ai_not_configured: The AI isn't set up on this system yet.

errors.ai_failed: The AI couldn't reply. Try again.
errors.transcription_failed: I couldn't transcribe the audio. Record it again or type your message.
errors.audio_too_large: That recording is too long. Try a shorter one.
errors.save_failed: The AI replied, but the message wasn't saved. Try again.
